name: CliqRelay
description: CliqRelay is an open-source platform that automatically transforms browser clicks and interactions into beautiful, step-by-step visual documentation and technical guides. By pairing a native browser extension with a high-performance backend, CliqRelay tracks exact DOM interactions and contextual screenshots, automating the heavy lifting of writing user manuals, onboarding documentation, and SOPs. Key Features: - Instant Capture: Record user workflows in real time using the CliqRelay Chrome/Firefox browser extension. - Contextual Screenshots: Automatically captures and crops screenshots for every click and interaction. - Live Recording Sidepanel: Start, pause, review, and watch steps populate live in the extension sidepanel. - Rich Guide Editor: Reorder steps, edit descriptions, blur sensitive details, and insert annotations (tips, callouts, alerts, headers). - PDF Export: Export polished, print-ready PDF guides for offline handoff and team sharing. - Guide Lifecycle Management: Star, publish, organize, and soft-delete guides with full restore capabilities. DEPLOYMENT & SETUP INSTRUCTIONS: CliqRelay consists of a web frontend, backend API, worker, PostgreSQL database, Redis, and RustFS object storage. Recommended: Docker Compose Manager on Unraid 1. Upstream provides a complete docker-compose.prod.yml in the repository. 2. Clone the repository into your appdata folder: [code]git clone https://github.com/CliqRelay/cliqrelay.git /mnt/user/appdata/cliqrelay[/code] 3. Copy docker-compose.prod.env.example to docker-compose.prod.env and configure your secrets: [code]cd /mnt/user/appdata/cliqrelay && cp docker-compose.prod.env.example docker-compose.prod.env[/code] 4. Build and start the stack with Docker Compose: [code]docker compose --env-file docker-compose.prod.env -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --build[/code] 5. Open the web interface at http:// :3000 and install the browser extension. Credits & Support: - CliqRelay is created by the CliqRelay Team ( GitHub ).
